Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this entertaining game. Bangladesh punched above their weight to beat England for the first time in T20Is and have taken a 1-0 lead in the 3-match series. The action now moves back to Dhaka for the final leg of England's tour. The second T20I is on 12th March (Sunday) at 2.30 pm IST (9 am GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Shakib Al Hasan, the captain of Bangladesh, says that he can't ask more from the team. Admits they were under the pump with the ball initially but no one panicked. Tells that in this format you don't need to think too much and that helps in the performance. Wants to build the same kind of fearless atmosphere in the dressing room. States that they are looking to build a team for the next World Cup and it's a good start for them.

Najmul Hossain Shanto (51 off 30 balls) is the Player of the Match. Says that Towhid Hridoy batted really well and he himself was only looking to play proper cricketing shots. Adds that the way Bangladesh bowled was superb and it helped the batters. Praises the opening partnership provided by Litton Das and Rony Talukdar as well.

Jos Buttler, the English skipper, says that Bangladesh finished the innings very well with the ball and England were perhaps 20 short. Adds that the pitch behaved as they expected and having a few extra runs on the board would have helped them. Praises Bangladesh for the way they showed the intent with the bat. Tells that England have a different balance in the team and he is blessed with plenty of bowling options.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

England have themselves to blame for this loss. They shot themselves in the foot after losing the plot in the end overs while batting. A strong platform was set but losing Jos Buttler and Ben Duckett off consecutive deliveries punctured their charge. The visitors mustered only 30 runs in the last five overs and finished with a below-par total. Credit to the way Bangladesh bounced back. Hasan Mahmud was exceptional in the death overs and must be commended for showing his control over variations.

It was an in-between target for the home team and the way they approached the chase was very refreshing. The openers were fearless and then the pair of Najmul Hossain Shanto and Towhid Hridoy capitalized in the middle phase. Their alliance in a way sealed the deal as the required rate dropped down below 6. There were a few nervy moments when both got dismissed in quick succession but the experience of Shakib Al Hasan came to the rescue. He kept the momentum and along with Afif Hossain finished the chase with relative ease in the end.

The Twenty20 world champions taken down! Bangladesh have done it. They have outplayed England. It's a lovely batting show from them, powered by some young and new faces. The next generation seems ready to take over for the Bangla Tigers.

FOUR! THAT'S IT! Bangladesh win by 6 wickets, with 12 balls to spare! Chris Jordan bowls this one full and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan throws his hands at it but gets an outside edge. The ball travels quickly and beats Mark Wood at third man for a boundary.
On a good length and angling in on middle, Afif Hossain turns this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Shakib Al Hasan frees his arms and slaps this one to deep cover for a run.
Fullish delivery outside off, from 'round the wicket, Shakib Al Hasan tries to dig this one out but does not connect.
FOUR! Slower and full outside off, Shakib Al Hasan picks the change of pace early and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Slower and on a length on off, Afif Hossain works this one to the right of mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Afif Hossain hangs back and runs this one down to third man for a single. Bangladesh within touching distance as they need just 10 more now.
FOUR! Goes full this time and outside off, Afif Hossain gets the width he needs and drives it well wide of deep cover for a boundary.
Keeps it slow and short on middle, Shakib Al Hasan waits for it and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower and back of a length down the leg side, Afif Hossain helps this one to fine leg for a single.

In the air but safe! Short of a length and aimed at the batter, Shakib Al Hasan swivels in his crease and goes for the pull. But, he gets a top edge that goes high in the air towards deep square leg. Neither Adil Rashid nor Sam Curran calls for the catch and the ball falls in no man's land. The batters cross for a single.
On a length on off, from 'round the wicket, Afif Hossain guides this one past backward point and crosses over for a single.
Jofra Archer is back on. 1 for 18 in his 2 overs so far.
Short and around off, Shakib Al Hasan stays on the back foot and works it to extra cover. Bangladesh need 19 from 24 balls.

FOUR! Moeen Ali shortens his length and bowls it outside off, Shakib Al Hasan rocks back in his crease and smashes this one over extra cover. Gets it right between long off and deep cover for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Tossed up, full and around off, Shakib Al Hasan picks the length early and steps out. Lofts it back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
A loud appeal for LBW but turned down! Fired in full and on middle, Afif Hossain gets down and goes for the sweep. Gets it to short fine leg for a single.
Full and at the stumps, Shakib Al Hasan gets behind the line and turns it to short fine leg for a single.
Short and turning away on off, Shakib Al Hasan makes room and dabs it to backward point.
Drifting down the leg side, on a length, Shakib tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to the keeper. 29 needed off 30 balls.
Aerial but safe. Fullish and around leg, Shakib tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes wide of the bowler to mid on. They cross.
Close to off, on a length, Shakib plays late and deflects it towards point. Afif looks for a run but Shakib sends him back.
On a length and outside off, Shakib plays off the back foot to point.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it to the off side.
FOUR! Short in length and wide outside off, Shakib slaps it through point for a boundary.
Chris Jordan is introduced into the attack.
Dropped! Tossed up around off, Afif Hossain mistimes his reverse sweep and Dawid Malan nearly pulls off a stunner at backward point. He jumps but fails to claim it over his head.
Full and around off, Afif plays the reverse sweep but finds Rashid at short third man.
Turning away from around off, Shakib goes back and plays it down in the gap at point for one.
Tossed up around off, Shakib walks forward and defends.
FOUR! Lucky one for Shakib. Flighted and around off, Shakib steps down the track to flick it across the line but gets a leading edge. It runs past Rashid at short third man for a boundary.
Tossed up around middle, defended on the leg side.
Express short ball again, around leg at 145.2 clicks, Afif attempts to pull but misses. End of a hostile over from Wood. 39 needed off 42 balls.
FOUR! Short in length around leg, at 145.8 kph, Afif Hossain gets inside the line of the delivery and pulls it wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
On a length, around off at 144.4 kph, Shakib stays back and nudges it to fine leg for one.
Pacy bouncer at 144.3 kph, around leg, Afif tries to pull but it takes the top edge. The ball falls at short fine leg as Buttler runs across. They cross.
Afif Hossain is the new man in. The stump cam has taken a blow and needs to be replaced. We are all set to resume now.

OUT! TIMBER! Mark Wood wins his battle with Najmul Hossain Shanto and has the last laugh. Back of a length, in the line of the stumps at 146.3 kph, Najmul Hossain Shanto hangs on the back foot to hit it across the line but the ball scoots low along with being express in pace and goes through. The stumps are shattered and Shanto is dismissed. Wood is delighted. Both the set batters are gone and England have an opening. 45 needed off 46 balls.
Sliding down the leg side, at 142.9 kph, Shakib eases it off his pads to deep square leg for one.
Mark Wood returns to the attack. He was expensive in his first over, conceding 17 runs.
A touch short around leg, staying low again, Shakib wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a run. A tidy over!
Drops it short, on middle, Shanto pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Presses forward and pushes a full ball gently to cover-point. Looks for a run but is sent back.
Skidding in, from around middle and leg, staying low as well, Shakib keeps it out in front of square leg and crosses.
Bangladesh skipper Shakib Al Hasan comes in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT! The crowd has gone silent. A wicket against the run of play. Floated delivery, full and around off, Towhid Hridoy walks forward to whip it across the line but it takes the toe end and flies towards mid-wicket. Sam Curran charges forward from the deep and takes the skier safely. End of a superb partnership. 49 needed off 52 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Curran b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: FIFTY FOR SHANTO, off just 27 balls. Tossed up around middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto works it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Leans forward to a full ball and helps it off the inner edge to square leg. They cross.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Skips down the track to a full ball and knocks it down to long on for a run.
SIX! High and handsome! Floated and full, around leg, right in the slot, Towhid Hridoy goes down on one knee and smokes it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Loopy and full, around leg, Hridoy defends it back and Rashid uses his right boot to stop the ball.
Short and on off, Shanto goes back and punches it to long on for a single.

Drinks break. The hosts are roaring in the second innings. A very fresh approach from their top order and Bangladesh have brought the required rate below 6 through sheer domination. England are under the pump and the only way they can bounce back is by picking wickets. Adil Rashid to bowl after the break, he has a change of ends.
Short and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto goes on the back foot and cuts it to deep backward point for a single.

Bowls this one full and on middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto closes the bat-face early as he tries to work it on the leg side. Gets a leading edge but luckily for him, the ball falls short of Moeen Ali.
FOUR! Tossed up, full and on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto makes room and goes inside out. Lofts it over covers and picks up a boundary.

Appeal for a run out! Short and turning away on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto plays it against the turn and places it in front of deep mid-wicket for a brace. The third umpire has a check but Shanto is safely in at the striker's end. The 50-run stand comes up between these two.
Floated, full outside off, Towhid Hridoy gets down and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Starts with a flighted delivery, full around off, Towhid Hridoy works this one to mid-wicket for a dot.
Moeen Ali to bowl now.
Short and on off, Towhid Hridoy pulls it along the ground to deep mid-wicket. Retains the strike with a single.
Goes full and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto knocks this one down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Nicely played! On a length around off by Sam Curran, Najmul Hossain Shanto allows the ball to come to him and opens the bat face at the last moment. Steers it between short third man and backward point for a boundary.
Fuller and on middle, Towhid Hridoy flicks this one to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes into the wicket and slower as well, outside off, Towhid Hridoy reaches out and dabs it to backward point.
Slower and back of a length on middle, Najmul Hossain Shanto works this one to deep square leg and takes a single.
Sam Curran (1-0-10-0) comes back into the attack.
Short and on off, Towhid Hridoy whips this one from the crease wide of long on and collects a couple of runs again. Another good over for Bangladesh.

Good running! Another googly, short and on leg, Towhid Hridoy goes on the back foot and places this one right between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg which allows him to return for the second run.
Tossed up, full and on middle and leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto gets forward and turns this one towards deep square leg for a run.
Short and at the stumps, Najmul Hossain Shanto rocks back in his crease and pulls it in front of deep mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs more.
FOUR! Googly, short and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto reads it well and cuts this one late. Gets it past backward point for a boundary.
Short and turning in on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto punches this one straight to extra cover.
Adil Rashid returns to bowl his second over. 1 for 5 so far from the leggie.
Short and outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto stands tall and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. An expensive first over by Mark Wood, 17 from it.

A stifled appeal for LBW but turned down! Slower and full, angling in on leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto misses the flick and gets hit on the front pad. England go up in appeal but the umpire's finger stays down.

FOUR! Najmul Hossain Shanto is in some mood here! Mark Wood goes short again and on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto hangs back and pulls it hard and wide of Chris Jordan at mid on for the fourth boundary of the over.
FOUR! Make that three in a row! Goes full and around off, Najmul Hossain Shanto presents a straight bat and drives it wide of mid off for yet another boundary.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Shortens his length and bowls it on off, Najmul Hossain Shanto stands tall and pulls it hard through mid-wicket. Gets it to the right of the deep square leg fielder for a boundary.

FOUR! Najmul Hossain Shanto welcomes Mark Wood with a boundary! Starts with a full delivery outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to go down the ground but does not go through with the shot. Chips this one just over the leaping Chris Jordan at mid on for a boundary.
Mark Wood has been unleashed into the attack.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Towhid Hridoy! Full and at the pads by Chris Woakes, Towhid Hridoy does not miss out as he flicks this one wide of fine leg for yet another boundary. At the end of the Powerplay, Bangladesh have scored 54 runs for the loss of two wickets.
FOUR! Fuller and outside off, Towhid Hridoy gets into the position early and drills it to the left of mid on. Collects his first boundary in T20I cricket.
Back of a length outside off, Towhid Hridoy gets behind the line of the ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Short of a length on off, Towhid Hridoy pulls this one hard and along the ground but fails to get it past mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Najmul Hossain Shanto opens the bat-face and guides it past backward point for a single.
Short and around off, Towhid Hridoy rides on top of the bounce and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and on off, at 119 kph, Towhid Hridoy works it to deep square leg for a single.
Debutant Towhid Hridoy walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Archer has his first wicket in the match. Goes short and delivers it around off at 133.2 kph, Litton Das tries to pull off the front foot but fails to middle his shot. It flies off the top edge to the right of mid on. Chris Woakes calls for it as Sam Curran is also nearby at mid-wicket. Woakes does well to claim the catch eventually. After a brisk start, Bangladesh have lost both their openers. England are clawing back.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Woakes b Jofra Archer

Commentary.Commentary: Slower one at 120.3 kph, around off, Das plays it down to short third man.
Digs it in short, on middle, Shanto plays a mistimed pull shot but gets it to clear the infield at mid-wicket. Chris Jordan chases it down from mid on and saves one run for his team.
Short again, outside off at 140.1 kph, Shanto steers it wide of backward point and collects a couple of easy runs.
Back of a length, around off at 141.4 kph, Das gets back and tucks it in front of square leg for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Rashid delivers it wide outside off, Shanto reaches out and swats it through the gap between extra cover and mid off. End of an eventful over.

Given lbw! Shanto has a word with Das and takes the DRS. Yet another googly from Rashid. It's full and around leg, Najmul Hossain Shanto goes down to play the reverse sweep but misses. He is pinged on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up. DRS time. The UltraEdge loads after some delay and finds a little bit of spike as the ball is next to the gloves. Shanto survives.
Flatter and shorter, on off, Shanto goes back and plays it down to point.
Najmul Hossain Shanto comes in at number 3 for Bangladesh.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Adil Rashid brings his experience and skills into play. Bowls a well-disguised googly, landing full around off, Rony Talukdar presses forward to drive against the turn and misses. It beats the inside part of his bat and goes on to rattle the stumps. England have their first breakthrough and the quickfire opening stand has been broken.
Loopy and full, around leg, Rony tries to flick but misses.
Floated and full, around leg, Das flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Change from both ends as Adil Rashid comes on from the other end.
FOUR! Boom! Archer clocks close to 140 clicks. Delivers it short and on off, Rony Talukdar rides the bounce and pulls it disdainfully past mid-wicket for a boundary. 11 from the third over as well.
Slower length ball, around off at 118 kph, Das turns it to square leg for a run.
Wide! Slips a full ball down the leg side, Das tries to flick but misses.
FOUR! A very bright start from Bangladesh. Archer dishes out a length ball around off, Litton Das walks across the stumps and scoops behind Adil Rashid at short fine leg.
Archer goes short again, around off, it's pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, tapped down to point.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, around off at 136 clicks, Rony Talukdar stays back to pull but misses.
Jofra Archer comes on to bowl, replacing Sam Curran.
Uses the angle of the bowler and works a length delivery to the right of mid-wicket. Ront picks up a single and Bangladesh fetch 11 runs from the second over. Positive start.
FOUR! Smashed! Full in length, around off, Rony Talukdar hurries down the track and clubs it straight down the ground for a cracking boundary.
Beaten! Serves it on a length, around off and shaping away, Rony pushes inside the line and misses.
FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard. Short in length and wide outside off, Rony Talukdar throws his bat at it and edges it over short third man for a boundary.
A touch short and on middle, Talukdar plays a wristy glance to deep backward square leg. The fielder does well in the deep to make a sliding stop but cannot prevent two runs.
Length delivery, around off and angling in, Rony defends it from the back foot to short cover.
Chris Woakes will operate from the other end.

Mishit! Curran slows down the pace as he serves it a bit short and outside off. Das attempts to pull but gets a bottom edge. The ball goes behind to the keeper. 10 from the opening over, a good start for the home team.
On a length around off, Rony bunts it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Bang! Rony is away with a boundary as well. Short in length and wide outside off, Rony Talukdar camps back and smacks it through extra cover.
Around middle and leg, Das steps out and wrists it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Wow, intent from Litton. Shortish and around off, Litton Das gives the charge and clobbers it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Bangladesh are away!
Curran begins with a good-length delivery, around off and angling away, Das stays back and plays it down to point.
